mapper.insert: insert into chat_user_config ( user_name, last_used_ai_model, created_by, created_time ) values ( #{userName}, #{lastUsedAiModel}, #{createdBy}, #{createdTime} )
mapper.select: select pkid, user_name as userName, last_used_ai_model as lastUsedAiModel, created_by as createdBy, created_time as createdTime from chat_user_config where user_name = #{userName} order by pkid desc limit 1
